description: This file defines the SkillDao class, which provides data access methods for the Skill entity within the OrangeHRM project. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, deleting, and searching skills, leveraging Doctrine ORM for database interactions.

classes.name: SkillDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for Skill entity, handling CRUD operations and search functionalities.

methods.name: saveSkill
methods.description: Saves a Skill entity to the database.

methods.name: getSkillById
methods.description: Retrieves a Skill by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingSkillIds
methods.description: Fetches IDs of skills that exist from a given list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteSkills
methods.description: Deletes skills based on provided list of IDs.

methods.name: searchSkill
methods.description: Searches for skills based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchSkillPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator for skill search based on filters.

methods.name: getSearchSkillsCount
methods.description: Counts the number of skills matching search criteria.
